task_name: C3-M1: Copay for a Park Avenue visit
intent: Open by saying you are Jordan Lee, date of birth April twelfth nineteen ninety, an existing Straus patient, and you need your copay for a regular visit at Park Avenue on August twenty-fourth, twenty twenty-six. You are an existing Straus patient. You want to know your copay for a regular visit at Park Avenue on August twenty-fourth, twenty twenty-six. If they ask who you are, give your name and date of birth once, confirm the readback, then continue with the copay. They should already have Aetna on file, but you know your member ID is W123456789. If they ask for the member ID after they have looked you up, give that exact ID. Once they tell you the copay, thank them and end the call. Do not ask to book, reschedule, or cancel. Do not ask to change insurance. Do not ask for a callback, to speak to a person, a payment, the patient portal, a waitlist, a text, financing, or the street, floor, or suite. If they try to quote a copay without looking you up, give your name and date of birth again and ask them to pull your chart. Stay until they have looked up the copay on your chart. A spoken guess without a lookup is not enough.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your full name and date of birth, or asks you to confirm who you are, or asks for the patient's name and date of birth. NOT when asking only for a member ID or insurance card, NOT when asking which office or location, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number, NOT when asking about an appointment day or time, NOT when reading your name and date of birth back to you for confirmation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Jordan Lee. My date of birth is April twelfth, nineteen ninety.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your member ID or insurance card before verifying you or opening your chart. NOT when they already looked you up or verified you, NOT when they are reading a member ID back for confirmation, NOT when asking only for the visit date or which office.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please verify me and pull my chart first. My Aetna information should already be on file.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your member ID after saying your identity was verified or your chart was opened. NOT when they are reading the member ID back for confirmation, NOT before identity verification.
scripted_responses.response_value: My Aetna member ID is W123456789.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads your name and date of birth back to you and asks whether that is right before saying your identity was verified or your chart was opened. NOT when first asking for your name and date of birth, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number, NOT after identity has already been verified.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, that's right. Please verify me and pull my chart before checking the copay; my Aetna information is already on file.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your insurance carrier, member ID, provider, or other coverage details after only reading your name and date of birth back, without saying your identity was verified or your chart was opened. NOT when they have already verified you or pulled your chart.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please verify me and pull my chart first. I am an existing patient, and my Aetna information is already on file.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: after verifying you or opening your chart, offers to continue with a coverage team, benefits check, eligibility check, or copay check to get the live copay. NOT when offering a human callback or front desk.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, please continue with the coverage check and tell me the copay from the system.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the front desk, or a live agent. NOT when you already asked for a person, NOT when they are completing the booking or cancel.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers the waitlist, a later opening, or to add you to a list. NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now, NOT when asking for your name or date of birth.
scripted_responses.response_value: No waitlist. Please just finish what I asked.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to text you a confirmation, directions, or an appointment SMS. NOT when asking for a payment-link number, NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thanks, I don't need a text.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: quotes a copay, deductible, or visit cost without saying they looked it up on your chart. NOT when they have just said they ran an eligibility or copay check.
scripted_responses.response_value: Can you look that up on my chart? I need the copay from the system, not a guess.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: starts an eligibility or copay lookup without first confirming your identity, or asks for insurance details without verifying your name and date of birth. NOT when identity has already been verified.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please verify me first. I'm Jordan Lee, born April twelfth, nineteen ninety.
